title: Facilities
content: Modern classrooms; research laboratories; software laboratories; department-specific practical facilities; faculty and academic support; industry-oriented learning and projects; computer/software laboratories; Wi-Fi; online student support; digital/technology-based learning.

title: Campus 1 Management & Business Block
content: Management, entrepreneurship and foundational business courses. Large-capacity smart classrooms with multimedia projection, smart/whiteboards and climate control. Core administrative offices, including the Management Department Head and general student support, are on the main floor. Main seminar halls and executive conference rooms.

title: MT Block (Management Teaching Block)
content: Management teaching classrooms, business and entrepreneurship academic spaces, and general student support spaces.

title: ET Block (Engineering & Technology Block)
content: Technical classrooms with surveillance systems and multimedia boards; computer labs, mechanical engineering shops, civil engineering practical areas, and electrical labs. Engineering and IT offices are on administrative wings.

title: Pharmacy & Medical Block
content: Pharmacy and Medical Laboratory Sciences wings, smart classrooms, pharmacology, pharmaceutics and biochemistry labs. Pharmacy and MLS HOD rooms are at the entrance levels of their respective wings.

title: HM Block (Hotel Management Block)
content: Hospitality-themed theory rooms, mock hotel room, furnished laundry setup, working bakery, training kitchens and mock front desk. Department offices are adjacent to the mock front desk and hospitality reception lounge.

title: Fashion Design & Journalism Blocks
content: Fashion design studios and garment production lab; Journalism & Mass Communication studios for radio broadcasting, podcasting, TV anchoring, photography and videography editing. Specific room numbers and live room availability are not supplied; check the timetable or ask campus staff.

title: Campus infrastructure and location
content: Campus 1 and Campus 2 are reported to be about one kilometer apart on Baddowal Road, Ludhiana. Campus 2 is near Baddowal Cantt, Jhande/Ferozepur Road, Ludhiana – 142021, Punjab, India. Dedicated academic blocks include Management Teaching (MT), Engineering & Technology (ET), Pharmacy, Hotel Management (HM), and Journalism/Fashion Design (FD). Air-conditioned, technology-enabled classrooms with smart boards, projectors and audio-visual aids. Campus-wide Wi-Fi. Central libraries with textbooks, reference materials, digital databases and international research journals. Computer and engineering labs, biotechnology and pharmacy labs, fashion design studios, seminar/conference halls. Check with campus staff for current facility locations and access hours.

Base/advanced kitchens and a working bakery support hands-on hospitality training. Outlets described include Coca-Cola (Just Baked), Bru Gold and beverage vending machines across academic blocks. Separate boys’ and girls’ hostel mess facilities serve daily meals at subsidized rates. Menus, rates and availability may change.
